claims.statement: Native POST /chat and OpenAI POST /v1/chat/completions both build a ChatCommand and call ChatService complete or stream; they do not import LiteLLM.
Structured output cannot be combined with streaming on either chat encoder; that pairing raises SchemaError.
POST /v1/embeddings applies budget and identity RPM then calls LiteLLMRouterRuntime.aembedding, not ChatService.
The published route surface includes native chat, OpenAI chat and embeddings, health, ready, metrics, config, memory, and admin keys.
